rule: A gap is a candidate only when independently useful for Pictiq.

candidates.reason: A generic person is useful in travel, interpersonal and safety messages without encoding gender or pronoun grammar.
Home/building is independently useful beyond the current specific hotel, shop and landmark tiles.
Visual attention is useful, but an eye may be read as surveillance or anatomy and needs testing.
Clothing can support travel and physical needs, but the existing fashion-shopping tile may already cover some contexts.
A body concept could support medical communication, but its scope and silhouette need evidence.
Heat/fire warnings are independently useful, while warmth and burning should not be conflated without testing.
Cold is useful for comfort and safety, but frozen/raw senses should remain outside a first tile.
Scale modifiers could help physical requests, but must not inherit age, importance or evaluation senses.
